name: bada-cinevim
description: Bada CineVim — a cinematic VIM editor for the Bada quantum programming language. It sets multi-paragraph prose as sentence blocks and blows the pointed block up in place — no magnifying glass needed. Scale falls off as a Gaussian in block distance, and an offset of sum_{j<i} h_j(s_j-1) + h_i(s_i-1)/2 keeps blocks from ever overlapping while using transforms only, so there is no per-frame relayout. As you read on, a travelling wave spreads outward from each new focus — the prose undulates and the crests flash — and because the blocks run continuously across paragraph boundaries, the wave carries over when you jump paragraphs with } or {. The line start never moves and the measure is derived from the zoom, so even the largest block stays on screen. Underneath it is still a line buffer, so every VIM motion and operator keeps working, and Japanese IME input is supported. Also includes a depth-of-field code view, an event-processing flash effect driven by an event bus, an Academy-leader movie countdown and a quantum Bada runtime (qubit / H / CNOT / measure). Self-contained HTML app, zero dependencies, fully offline.
author: Masaaki Yamaguchi
